content.value: On April 1, 2015 Mr. Mahim established Travel Agency. The following (25) transactions were completed during the month.
2015 April 01 Invested cash to start the agency Tk 2,00,000.
2015 April 02 Paid cash for April office rent Tk 8000
2015 April 05 Purchased office equipment for Tk 50,000.
2015 April 10 Incurred advertising cost on account Tk 2,600.
2015 April 15 Paid cash for office supplies Tk 2000.
2015 April 16 Earned Tk 1,90,000 for services rendered, Tk 20,000 cash is received from customers and the balance of Tk 1,70,000 is billed to customers on account.
2015 April 17 Withdraw Tk 4,000 cash for Owner's personal use.
2015 April 18 Paid accounts payable due in April 10.
2015 April 30 Received Tk 1,70,000 is cash from customers who have previously been billed in transaction dated 16.
Instruction: Journalize the above transactions in the book of Mr. Mahim.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
